scenes.say: That golden foam? It fools you.
It's just gas. Roasting traps carbon dioxide in the beans. Oils hold the bubbles.
Fresher beans hold more gas. Older beans, thinner foam.
Honey color, fine bubbles: promising. Pale and loose? Less so.
Lots of crema isn't proof. It hints at freshness, not flavor.
Crema is a clue, not a score. Save this, then taste.
